title: Tailscale: Backend Engineer, Control Plane
description_review: Remote Canada backend engineer role on Tailscale's Control Plane team building secure network interconnection services and open-source clients. Engineers own the full lifecycle from product ideation to writing backend code and scaling distributed services. Focuses on networking infrastructure, control plane scalability, and distributed systems.
pros: High-reliability distributed backend services and control plane architecture
Full-lifecycle engineering ownership from system design to production deployment
cons: Listed as Remote (Canada), which may restrict non-Canadian applicants
Specialized networking/VPN infrastructure rather than enterprise Java/Spring microservices

title: Stripe: Abuse Research Engineer
description_review: Remote US role in Stripe's Abuse Research Group conducting proactive threat hunting and fraud attack analysis across global payment infrastructure. Uses agentic automated testing and simulation tools to translate security research into strategic controls and regression tests. High-impact financial ecosystem security engineering requiring advanced adversary simulation.
pros: Leading financial infrastructure domain directly matches candidate's banking/fintech background
Applies agentic automated testing tools and security simulation, aligning with agentic systems knowledge
cons: Role is specialized cybersecurity / adversary abuse research rather than core software application engineering
Remote US designation may restrict international applicants

title: Lithic: Senior Risk Associate
description_review: Remote role at payments processor Lithic running client and third-party risk assessment programs, enterprise risk registers, and underwriting operations. The role oversees compliance rubrics, credit limits, reserve recommendations, and vendor assessments. Pure financial compliance and risk management operations role with no software development.
pros: Fintech and banking card issuance ecosystem matches industry background
cons: Non-technical risk assessment and compliance operations position with zero software development
Total mismatch for a Senior Software Engineer profile

title: Salesloft: Principal Software Engineer, AI
description_review: Remote US Principal AI Engineer position at Salesloft leading technical direction for predictive revenue systems and LLM agentic workflows at enterprise scale. Sets architecture for serving models, agentic orchestration, and translating machine intelligence into production capabilities. Top-level individual contributor role driving AI system architecture.
pros: Architecting agentic workflows and LLM orchestration aligns directly with candidate's multi-agent platform and harness expertise
Enterprise-grade platform scale matches 7+ years enterprise software and architecture background
High-impact technical leadership in applied AI engineering
cons: Principal-level scope may expect previous dedicated staff/principal title

title: Lithic: Senior Software Engineer, Card Authorization
description_review: Remote senior software engineer role on Lithic's Card Authorization team building real-time transaction processing, rules engines, and 3D Secure integrations. Replaces legacy 30-year-old payment mainframes with modern distributed systems handling high-speed card authorization decisions. Core backend fintech engineering role focused on high reliability, scale, and low latency.
pros: Modernizing legacy payment mainframes into high-performance real-time distributed systems is an exceptional match for candidate's modernization background
Banking/fintech card transaction processing directly parallels 6+ years banking backend at ICBC and BBVA
Senior distributed systems engineering with high-reliability authorization and rules engine ownership
cons: Specific programming language not explicitly mentioned in the excerpt (Lithic typically uses Python/Go/Java)
